definitions.explanation: Monetary donations given to content creators during live streams or to support their work, typically through platforms like YouTube, Twitch, or Japanese services.
The original meaning: coins thrown to street performers or into offering boxes at shrines and temples.

examples.japanese: {配信者|はいしんしゃ}に{投|な}げ{銭|せん}をした。
{投|な}げ{銭|せん}で{月|つき}に{10万円|じゅうまんえん}{稼|かせ}ぐ{配信者|はいしんしゃ}もいる。
examples.english: Some streamers earn 100,000 yen a month from tips.

examples.japanese: {大道芸人|だいどうげいにん}に{投|な}げ{銭|せん}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I threw some coins to the street performer.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: {投|な}げる (to throw) + {銭|せん} (coin/money). Originally referred to coins thrown to performers or into offering boxes.

MODERN USAGE:
In the 2010s-2020s, {投|な}げ{銭|せん} became the standard Japanese term for online tipping on streaming platforms. It covers features like:
・スーパーチャット (Super Chat on YouTube)
・{投|な}げ{銭|せん} features on Japanese platforms
・Donations on Twitch and similar services

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{投|な}げ{銭|せん}をする/する (to tip)
・{投|な}げ{銭|せん}を{送|おく}る (to send a tip)
・{投|な}げ{銭|せん}を{もらう|貰|もら}う (to receive tips)
・{投|な}げ{銭|せん}{文化|ぶんか} (tipping culture)

RELATED TERMS:
・スーパーチャット/スパチャ (Super Chat)
・{配信|はいしん} (live streaming)
・{配信者|はいしんしゃ} (streamer)
・{投|な}げる (to throw, also used alone for tipping)
・{課金|かきん}する (to spend money on digital content)
